title: serving-runtime daily scratchpad 2026-03-07
body:
Daily scratchpad - Marcus (serving-runtime)
2026-03-07

Top goals for today:
- unblock 1423 (OOM on KV cache grow for 8k seqs)
- land alt-kernel bench harness + perf numbers for 4096/8192
- triage customer report: 99th-p50 spike on dedicated nodes (region-us-west-2)

Notes / quick context:
- Issue #1423: reproducer uses 2x<gpt-neox-20b>-style config with continuous batching + prefix caching. Observed KV cache growth beyond expected when two near-concurrent requests cause cache duplication during warmup. Hypothesis: race in cache-attach path (cache refcounting bug).
  - Repro steps: ./scripts/repro_kv_oom.sh --model gpt-neox-20b --seq 8192 --concurrency 2
  - Quick patch idea: add atomic compare-exchange in attach_cache and add a short backoff when another thread is creating cache. Try in branch fix/kv-attach-race.
  - Related: PR #1480 attempts similar but may break warmup timing. Need to run unit+stress.

Perf TODOs:
- alt-kernel harness: add measurement for attention kernel when seq=4096, batch=1, beam=1. Currently kernel selection chooses tiled-attn-v2 which regresses at long seq. Plan: run tiled-attn-v1, v2, and fused-kv to compare.
  - Command: python bench/alt_kernel_bench.py --model gpt-7b --seq 4096 --iters 50 --kernels tiled-v1,tiled-v2,fused-kv
  - Target: show <10% regression vs baseline (tiled-v1) otherwise fallback to v1 for seq>2048 via kernel selector heuristics.

- Quantization note: 4-bit dynamic quantization shows ~1.8x speedup on A100S for small batches but increases tail latency for batch>4. Need to add batching-aware quantization policy in runtime config. TODO: add config flag quant_policy.batch_threshold=4.

Kernel dev notes (quick):
- attention_split_cuda.cu: look at index recompute in compute_indices(); suspect off-by-one for block_idx when seq%tile==0. Add assert for (seq%tile == 0) branch.
- fused_matmul.cu: experiment with prefetch distance=128 vs 64 for A100S; previous run shows 4% throughput improvement with 128 for seq=2048.

Triage items:
- Customer: ACME corp sees latency spikes at 99p during peak. Data from logs: bursts coincide with autoscaler events where new GPUs are added and some requests get routed to warm nodes with cold KV cache. Proposed mitigations:
  1) warmup tier that pre-populates KV cache when node joins for top-5 models (fast path)
  2) route ephemeral small requests to warm nodes only; new nodes go to warmup queue for 60s
  3) optimistic prefetch for recent prefixes (cheap heuristic)
- Action: create RFC/issue describing warmup flow and perf expectations (link RFC to JIRA SRV-591). Priya to draft.

Meetings / syncs:
- 10:30 sync with infra (autoscaler) - confirm metrics emitted for node-warm vs node-ready. Need new metric node_cache_ready{node,model}.
- 15:00 kernel review with Liam - show alt-kernel bench results and decide selector rule.

Quick commands / reproduce notes:
- repro kv oom: ./scripts/repro_kv_oom.sh --model gpt-neox-20b --seq 8192 --concurrency 2 2>&1 | tee repro_1423.log
- run alt-kernel: python bench/alt_kernel_bench.py --model gpt-7b --seq 4096 --iters 50 --kernels tiled-v1,tiled-v2,fused-kv
- stress test: ./tools/stress-client --target=https://dedicated-us-west2.redwood/api --rps=1200 --qps=1200 --duration=10m --model=gpt-7b

Open questions / followups:
- Is there a common pattern where cache duplication happens only when requests share the same prefix vs different prefixes? Add test coverage for same-prefix concurrency.
- For quantization: can we detect batch size at kernel select time cheaply? Might be exposed via req.meta.batch_size. TODO: add to selector API.

Misc notes / random:
- Consider adding small per-node background worker that scans recent prefixes and fetches their KV entries into an LRU prewarm cache (bounded). Could help 99p for interactive workloads.
- Remember to link bench outputs to Confluence page perf-benchmarks-2026 after today's runs.

Next steps (today):
- morning: repro + try atomic CE fix for kv attach (branch fix/kv-attach-race)
- lunch: run alt-kernel bench across A100S and H100 images
- afternoon: sync with infra (10:30) + kernel review (15:00).

Notes-to-self: commit small tests for cache attach race, mark flaky test in CI if non-deterministic. Keep PRs small; pair with Priya on warmup RFC.

---
End of scratchpad
